channel.title: Scandinavian Nomads
channel.description: Budget-luxury travel guides, tips and weekly travel news from a Norwegian traveller who has visited 90+ countries.

item.title: The first weekly roundup is coming soon
item.description: Every Monday we will round up the travel news that matters for budget-luxury travellers.

item.title: Mexico City
item.description: Leafy neighbourhoods, design hotels and some of the world's best food at every price point.

item.title: Lofoten
item.description: Arctic drama, fishermen's cabins and midnight light, done the smart way.

item.title: Lisbon
item.description: Tiled facades, river light and boutique stays for a fraction of Paris prices.

item.title: Kyoto
item.description: Temples, gardens and ryokan calm, without the ryokan price every night.

item.title: Hong Kong
item.description: Five-star skyline views, Michelin dim sum and ferries that cost less than a coffee.

item.title: Cape Town
item.description: Mountains, ocean, wine country and world-class dining at pleasantly local prices.

item.title: Shoulder season: the secret to five-star trips for less
item.description: When to go to get great weather, fewer crowds and lower prices.

item.title: Pack light, travel well: the carry-on capsule
item.description: A simple capsule wardrobe that fits in a cabin bag and looks good from a city break to a five-star dinner.

item.title: Airport lounge access without flying business
item.description: The main ways to get into airport lounges on an economy ticket, and when they are worth it.

item.title: Fine dining at lunch prices
item.description: Why lunch is the smartest way to eat at great restaurants, and how to find the best deals.

item.title: Business class on points: a beginner's guide for Scandinavians
item.description: How to start collecting points in Norway, Sweden and Denmark and turn them into a lie-flat seat.

item.title: How to book boutique hotels for less
item.description: Eight practical ways to get design-hotel style at mid-range prices.
